responsibility: Implements the C++ side of the Rust formatting-string parser bridge used by the frontend’s `format_args!` support. It wraps the external FFI routines that parse a format string into pieces, manages cloning and destruction of the underlying Rust-owned handle, materializes a C++ vector of parsed `ffi::Piece` records, and provides string conversion for FFI string slices, making it the ownership and conversion layer between the frontend AST and the underlying format parser.
same_name_distinction: Implements the runtime and ownership side of the format-parser bridge declared in `rust-fmt.h`, including `Pieces` collection, cloning, destruction, and `RustHamster` string conversion; the header primarily defines the FFI structs and RAII wrapper interface.
